issues.title: Name the trash icon for VoiceOver
issues.description: The delete control is a bare `Image(systemName: "trash")` with no visible text and no `.accessibilityLabel`, so VoiceOver gives at best a generic symbol name and never says which plant gets deleted. Apple's accessibilityLabel docs say to label views that show an icon instead of text.

issues.title: Expose the trash icon as a button
issues.description: The trash image triggers `store.delete(plant)` through `.onTapGesture`, but it has no `.isButton` trait, so VoiceOver and Switch Control announce a static image and give no sign that it acts. Shares its root cause with EB-003 and EB-019; converting to `Button` fixes all three.

issues.title: Make the delete tap target at least 44x44 pt
issues.description: The HIG Buttons page says a button needs a hit region of at least 44x44 pt. The trash target is a 28x28 pt frame with no content shape, so taps near the icon miss. Twin of EB-004; the fixes intentionally match.

issues.title: Confirm before deleting a plant
issues.description: A single tap on the trash icon calls `store.delete(plant)` right away, with no confirmation and no undo, so a stray tap permanently removes the plant. The HIG says to show an alert for destructive actions that can't be undone.

issues.title: Mark the delete control as destructive
issues.description: The control runs `store.delete(plant)` but is a plain image with a tap gesture, so it can't carry `role: .destructive`, and the system can't show it in red or treat it as dangerous. The HIG defines the destructive role for buttons that can destroy data.

issues.title: Expose "Water now" as a button
issues.description: "Water now" is a `Text` with `.onTapGesture`, so VoiceOver reads it as static text and users don't know they can activate it to water the plant. Shares its root cause with EB-009 and EB-020.
issues.ai_fix_prompt:
Edit {{PROJECT_PATH}}/PlantCare/Views/PlantDetailView.swift lines 20-26 (EB-008).
Clause A11Y-A11Y-001: Expose "Water now" as a button. "Water now" is a `Text` with `.onTapGesture`, so VoiceOver reads it as static text and users don't know they can activate it to water the plant.

Original:
```swift
            Text("Water now")
                .padding()
                .background(Color.green)
                .onTapGesture {
                    store.water(plant)
                }
                .sensoryFeedback(.error, trigger: store.didSave)
```

Replace with:
```swift
// Add to PlantDetailView: @State private var justWatered = false
Button {
    store.water(plant)
    justWatered = true
} label: {
    Label(justWatered ? "Watered" : "Water now",
          systemImage: justWatered ? "checkmark.circle.fill" : "drop")
        .foregroundStyle(.black) // fixed dark label on the bright green fill: 9.5:1 light, 10.4:1 dark
}
.buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
.tint(.green)
.sensoryFeedback(.success, trigger: store.didSave)
```

Image(systemName: "drop.fill")
    .font(.largeTitle)
    .symbolEffect(.pulse, options: .repeating, isActive: !reduceMotion)
    .accessibilityHidden(true)
